card.name: Copyright notice endings on web articles
card.fires_on: The period after a copyright line such as "All rights reserved" or "Healthwise, Incorporated" at the end of a web article. It also fires on words inside source-attribution notices about edited content.

modes.label: Period after copyright line
modes.description: The full stop ending a copyright or rights-reserved statement, just before more legal text.
modes.example: (Copyright 2013 KARE. All rights reserved<<.>> This material may not be published, broadcast

modes.label: Words in editing notices
modes.description: Words such as new, added or original inside a note about content edited by site staff.
modes.example: Topic editors and authors for the Encyclopedia of Earth may have edited its content or added<< new>> information.

card.writes: It seems to push toward starting a new legal or disclaimer line, but the listed tokens give little clear guidance.
card.plain: It lights up at the end of copyright and rights-reserved notices at the bottom of web articles.
